title: Test-Time Scaling for Open-Ended Reasoning at Small Model Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.02208v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A vote over a model's samples can only help when the samples disagree. For open-ended generation the binding question is therefore not how to combine samples but whether a model produces samples worth combining, a question test-time scaling has answered for math but not for free-form text. We study it at small scale with semantic cluster voting, a judge-free aggregator that groups a small instruct model's samples by meaning and returns the largest cluster's representative, with no reward model or self-judging. On a 250-prompt benchmark with three tiers of answer checkability, the same pattern holds across three model families (Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B, Gemma-2-2B) and two generation seeds: voting raises accuracy on the math control, where samples vary but stay checkable (a gain of +10 to +29 points across the three models), yet adds at most +0.30 judge points on open-ended text. translated_title: 小规模模型开放式推理的测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 对模型的样本进行投票只有在样本之间存在分歧时才有帮助。因此，对于开放式生成而言，关键问题不是如何组合样本，而是模型是否能产生值得组合的样本——测试时扩展已经为数学问题回答了这一问题，但尚未为自由形式文本回答。我们在小规模下用语义聚类投票研究该问题，这是一种无需裁判的聚合方法，它按语义对小指令模型的样本进行分组，并返回最大簇的代表样本，全程不使用奖励模型或自我评判。在一个包含三个答案可核查性等级的250条提示基准上，该模式在三个模型家族和两个生成种子中保持一致：投票显著提升了数学对照任务上的准确率（三个模型的增益为+10至+29分），但在开放式文本上最多仅提升+0.30的裁判分。在一次规模更大的200题MATH-500运行中，主要模
tldr: 该研究提出无需裁判模型的语义聚类投票方法，在小规模模型上发现测试时投票能将数学推理准确率提升10至29分，但对开放式自由文本生成几乎没有收益，说明测试时扩展对开放性文本的价值取决于模型能否产生值得聚合的样本。
en_tdlr: Using judge-free semantic cluster voting on small instruct models, this study shows that test-time voting boosts math accuracy by +10 to +29 points but yields at most +0.30 judge points on open-ended text, revealing that test-time scaling only helps when a model produces samples worth aggregating.
